name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Business Operations Leader | Analytics, Process & AI-Driven Efficiency
summary: Business operations and analytics leader with full operational accountability as a solo founder for the past two and a half years, building the operating cadence, reporting, and cross-functional systems a growing team typically relies on a business partner to hold together. Brings 15+ years of SaaS account and program management experience translating operational detail into clear priorities and decisions, plus daily hands-on use of AI tools to move faster, the same operating rhythm Deepgram is built around.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Break down manual operating workflows into agent architectures with custom logic that scores engagement signals and generates targeted, personalized outreach, applying AI and automation to improve day-to-day operational workflows.

Translate non-technical stakeholders' generalized ideas and feedback into precise, structured AI prompts and agent instructions, acting as the bridge between business intent and reliable system output.
Design self-improving loops and evaluation frameworks to monitor automation outputs, catching inconsistencies and continuously optimizing performance.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to executive leadership.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and strategic recommendations, backed by rigorous tracking across sales enablement, marketing, and operations.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping project records and commitments auditable across concurrent engagements.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows, equipping them to communicate product value.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (a team of 20, later a team of 8), overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.

Drove team initiatives and process improvements for a brand-new Wix vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, contributing to hiring, onboarding, and training of new hires and developing sales training for tenured account executives.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, building relationships with C-Suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Advised clients on CRM adoption, building scalable operational systems aligned to their growth stage and team structure.
Escalated issues to leadership early and mitigated account-level risk with direct strategic guidance.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
